notes.title: Evil West - New Update (1.0.5)
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Hunters![/h2]

Our new update is now live on Steam! The complete patch notes is available down below, happy reading!

[h2]COSMECTICS[/h2]

- Added a new stylish coat, hat and scarf, called the Invincible set. It’s rewarded for the players who complete the entire game in True Death mode. Please note that in order to get the Invincible set, you need to complete a True Death playthrough after updating the game. 

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]

[h3]ALL PLATFORMS[/h3]

- While sporting the Invincible set of clothes, the player regains a small amount of HP with every Gauntlet damage dealt to the enemies. This feature works even with only one piece of clothing equipped, but scales up with the remaining ones. 

[h2]BLOCKERS[/h2]

- Fixed a potential loss of entire game progress related to the True Death mode being accidentally turned on at the start of the NewGame+. 
- Fixed the infinite loading screen (a.k.a. infinite fade-from-black) glitch. 
- Fixed a possible Glamour related softlock while reloading the miniboss checkpoint in the Smoke & Mirrors mission. 
- Fixed the progression softlock if the player died and moved to the previous arena after respawn in The First Spark mission. 

[h2]BLOCKERS - COOP[/h2]

- Fixed a conditional blocker when both players die during the tutorial in certain points of the game. 
- Fixed a conditional blocker in The Heist mission where one player died to a gatling enemy. 
- Fixed a conditional blocker, when two players used the traversal interactions before the waterfall section of the Devil’s Pass mission. 

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]

[h3]ALL PLATFORMS[/h3]

- Fixed the bug causing the player and/or enemies falling underneath the level after using the Touchdown perk. 
- Fixed couple instances where the player could get permanently stuck inside the ground. 
- Fixed an exploit allowing the players to continue the True Death mode playthrough even after death. 
- Fixed the Sticky Sticks upgrade causing occasional performance and stability issues. 
- Fixed multiple places where the player could get stuck in the ground while using the Zapper skills. 
- Fixed the instances where enemies could stop respawning in some encounters of the Where Oil Smells Like Blood mission. 
- Fixed couple situations where the Scorcher hose was constantly flashing while using the weapon. 
-Fixed some of the secret chest collectables not being properly saved while replaying the mission from the Lore menu, effectively locking some players out of the Chest Nuts achievement/trophy. 
- Fixed the enemy weak spots not reacting to the Rifle shots with Railgun upgrade activated. 
- Fixed the possible Railgun upgrade charging VFX desynchronization caused by specific actions chaining. 
- Fixed the possible occlusion of breakable debris blocking the shooting targets in the cart ride sequence of the Remote RI Outpost mission. 

[h2]BUGFIXES - COOP[/h2]

- Tweaked the revive interaction, so that neither dodging nor damage can interrupt it in the heat of battle. 

[h2]XBOX[/h2]

- Fixed the players not being able to stream the game online straight from the console. 

[h2]PC[/h2]

- Fixed a controller stick not working properly if the player has two controllers plugged into the PC.

notes.title: Discover our Accolades Trailer!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello hunters![/h2]

We are delighted to share an Accolades Trailer to celebrate the very warm welcome [i]Evil West[/i] has been receiving! Discover some of its buzzing reviews in today’s Accolades Trailer.

[previewyoutube=WJFC7xMAElg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Highlighting the action in satisfaction[/h2]

Evil West has been garnering plentiful favorable reviews, reflecting the game’s wickedly satisfying, gory combat action; the bold and effective mix of genres behind its twisted, never-before-seen fantasy version of the Old West; and the blast it all provides as an old-school, over-the-top experience.

We are touched by so many warm words and thanking everyone for their reviews of the game so far. We wait to hear more from both the press and the players, as they battle bloodthirsty monsters through the Wild West.

[b]Evil West is now available on Steam.[/b]

notes.title: Evil West - First Update (1.0.4)
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Hunters![/h2]

Our first update is now live on Steam! The complete patch notes is available down below, happy reading!

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]

[h3]ALL PLATFORMS[/h3]

- You can now toggle the Camera Shake in the Game options.
- You can now restart the current mission from the Lore menu’s Missions section.

[h3]PC[/h3]

- You can now change the sprint action on keyboard to be a toggle instead of hold-to-sprint.
- The arrow cursor keys are not hard bound to the camera movement any more.
- Added the Exit button in the EULA screen upon the first launch of the game.
- You can now adjust the FOV (Field of View) angle in the options menu, which is especially useful if you own an ultrawide monitor.

[h2]BLOCKERS[/h2]

- The player is no longer blocked while replaying the Remote RI Outpost mission.
- The player can’t get blocked any more while destroying the glamour seals in the Smoke and Mirrors mission.
- The player won’t get blocked inside the Man of People mission while destroying the monster nests. Note: the mission needs to be restarted from the Lore menu for this fix to work.

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]

[h3]ALL PLATFORMS[/h3]

- Fixed the analogue sticks player movement not working on some controllers.
- Fixed a combat sound staying active after the enemy’s death for one of the large enemies.
- Fixed the player being able to throw the enemy out of the arena in The Questionable Cargo mission.
- Fixed the cases where starting or loading the mission could take too long and the screen would never fade out from black.
- Fixed some of the large enemies’ HP pools being wrong if the player switches difficulty mid-encounter.
- Fixed the player being able to shoot Revolver even on cooldown, when combined with swapping from the Scorcher.
- Fixed one of the traversal interactions being active during the encounter in the Where Oil Tastes Like Blood mission.
- Fixed the player animation stuttering while using the Rifle close to the enemy.
- Fixed the Crippling Rod not always working properly against the Highborn enemy ranged attacks.

[h3]COOP[/h3]

- Fixed the players being able to get soft-locked if they both died during tutorial in The First Spark mission.

notes.title: A first update is on its way!
notes.content:
Hey there Hunters!

We'd like to extend a huge thanks to all of you playing right now! Evil West is at the top of the charts and the team is glued to all the streams and videos - [h3]THANK YOU![/h3]

We read and compile your feedback and reports, and we're happy to announce that our first update to fix some of the issues you might have encountered will be released [b]very soon[/b]!

If you encounter any issues with the game, please submit a ticket in our [url=https://support.focus-home.com]support center[/url].

We’ll do our best to help you there, and it will help the team to fix the issue faster for all players.

notes.title: Evil West is out!
notes.content:
[h2]Finally Vampire Hunters![/h2]

Oh boy, it was a long journey. And today, we’re proud and happy to announce that Evil West is now available! 
But enough talking, it’s time to jump into the twisted, fantasy version of the Old West and battle bloodthirsty monsters in stylish, gory action combat.

[b]Watch the Launch Trailer now![/b]

[previewyoutube=5ERcyYnqU9M;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Evil never sleeps… but it bleeds![/h2]

A dark menace consumes the American frontier. As one of the last agents in a top-secret vampire-hunting institute, you are the final line between humanity and a deep-rooted terror that now emerges from the shadows. [b]Rise up to become a Wild West Superhero, eradicate the vampire threat and save the United States![/b]

[b]In visceral, explosive combat[/b], unleash hell with your firearms, lightning-fueled gauntlet and gadgets. Kill bloodthirsty monstrosities in style [b]as a lone hunter or in co-op with a friend.[/b] Explore and fight in a [b]narrative-driven campaign[/b] while upgrading your weapons and hunting tools. [b]Unlock new perks[/b] to evolve your monster-slaying mastery, crafting your own playstyle to ultimately defeat the supernatural hordes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322285/859bff0c7a37441fd5ae714b9743414494f009d8.jpg[/img]

[b]Evil West is now available on Steam. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065310/Evil_West/

notes.title: Welcome to Evil West!
notes.content:
[h3]Yeehaw Vampire Hunters! 🤠[/h3]

We’re just one week ahead of Evil West’s launch! We can’t wait to see you hunt down vampiric monstrosities in the Wild West, but before jumping in,[b] Danny Trejo has a message for you![/b]

[previewyoutube=ZmizdL1NpTA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Less distraction, more action[/h2]

If Evil West is nothing short of a blast, that’s thanks to an [b]explosive gameplay[/b] that rids itself from any extra, tedious worry. [b]Actor Danny Trejo, of badass film fame,[/b] is not one to let anything interfere with his smashing business. Naturally, Evil West is just his kind of video game: [b]a satisfying run of adrenaline that brings action fun back to basics.[/b]

[b]Jump right into fast-paced, over-the-top carnage in a vampire-infested Wild West.[/b] Eradicate bloodthirsty monstrosities in style with an overpowering arsenal of weapons and a lightning-fueled punch, combining brutal melee and ranged combos to dominate visceral boss fights and encounters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322285/d0f314d108f79bfab3f938011873c9106082b346.jpg[/img]

[b]Evil West releases November 22 on Steam, and pre-orders are open.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065310/Evil_West/

notes.title: Double the action in Evil West with our Co-op Gameplay Trailer!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We’re delighted to showcase you our new [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8CzVyQXJsY4]Co-op Gameplay Trailer[/url]! Join Tomasz Gop, lead producer at Flying Wild Hog, to discover more details about the multiplayer!

[previewyoutube=8CzVyQXJsY4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Take on monster hunting with a friend[/h2]

Designed as an [b]explosive solo action adventure at heart[/b], [i]Evil West [/i]does not shy away from offering the option to [b]turn an intrepid lone ranger’s journey into quality time slaying vampires with a buddy[/b]. It takes the form of an online cooperation mode that allows for two players to team up. Host and [b]invite a friend on a segment of your journey or take on all missions together[/b], blasting horrifying monsters in tandem and unleashing explosive combos in twice-the-fun, twice-the-style sequences. [b]Mix and match your characters’ weapons and skills for ever-expanding action possibilities![/b]

[b]Solo or with a friend, pre-order Evil West now and play November 22 on Steam.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065310/Evil_West/

notes.title: Discover our Gameplay Overview Trailer!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

[b]We’re happy to reveal our new Gameplay Overview Trailer![/b] Prepare for the vampire-infested American frontier, [b]releasing November 22 on Steam![/b]

[previewyoutube=wOghxjtU4Y0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]A heroic journey to achieve[/h2]

[b]Get to know Jesse Rentier, the young and skilled vampire slayer you’ll incarnate in Evil West.[/b] Star agent of the Rentier Institute, a secret monster-hunting organization led by his father and many generations of Rentier before him, he’ll have to take the action into his own hands after a deadly vampiric conspiracy emerges from the darkness and wipes out the Institute.
With the help of Edgar Gravenor, another survivor from the Rentier Institute, he’ll have to[b] battle fierce foes and demystify the conspiracy, while rebuilding the organization and becoming the leader it needs.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322285/31d42d0fa27b5e413f8f61dfaefec585f95c329e.jpg[/img]

[h2]A well-equipped gunslinger slaying monstrosities with deadly style[/h2]

To reach his goal, Jesse will [b]explore every corner of the Wild West[/b], looking for new Institute members and valuable leads on the conspiracy, taking money from abandoned chests and corpses and [b]growing his arsenal of weapons[/b] all the while. [b]Armed with both [url=https://youtu.be/cbtaSaKLwLk]old-fashioned firearms[/url] and advanced technology such as the lightning-fuelled [url=https://youtu.be/CXEj3swVJsY]Rentier Gauntlet[/url], combine Jesse’s weapons and tools to your liking[/b], each of them coming with its own skill tree for customized upgrades. Then [b]take part in explosive combat encounters with your own mix of powerful ranged attacks and devastating melee combos.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322285/859bff0c7a37441fd5ae714b9743414494f009d8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Don’t miss the Signature Edition![/h2]

Get your hands on the [b]ultra-limited Evil West – Signature Edition[/b], a Focus Entertainment Store exclusive product available in only [b]50 copies worldwide[/b]. It includes a numbered laminated wooden frame printed with an [b]exclusive artwork by artist Gabz[/b], a physical copy of the game with the Focus [b]exclusive box art[/b], and the Wild Wild East Skin Pack DLC. Don’t miss it, [url=https://store.focus-entmt.com/w/evilwestgames][b]pre-orders are now open[/b][/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322285/c5777c6214248b192521b375963b4859b7c36521.jpg[/img]

[b]Evil West releases November 22 on Steam with pre-orders already open.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065310/Evil_West/

notes.title: Evil West just revealed a new extended gameplay trailer!
notes.content:
Coming November 22 to Steam, the game fires you up in [b]12 exhilarating minutes of gameplay and cutscenes[/b], fully showcasing an early level in Evil West’s narrative-driven campaign and an additional boss fight. Watch this new extended gameplay video:

[previewyoutube=465zR0PkCnQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The evil plot thickens[/h3]
Today’s preview shows extended gameplay sequences and gives plenty of new narrative detail, introducing more plot and characters through the showcased level’s cutscenes.

[b]Discover a cowboys-meet-historical-figures-meet-gothic-horror world of corrupted politics and covered-up vampire situations[/b] within which young gunslinger Jesse Rentier and his father’s vampire-hunting organization, the Rentier Institute, play a central part.

Then plunge into the heat of the action as the Rentier Institute experiences a major crisis! Fight virulent hordes of bloodthirsty monsters in a burning building, unleashing your old-school rifle and cutting-edge Rentier Institute technology in an explosive mix of shooting and melee combat. The vampire menace hit hard and it will be up to you to eradicate it, starting November 22!
